description: This file contains implementation of message bus interface functions for a component, including message handling, bus engagement, initialization, finalization, resource freeing, and bus checking, primarily for inter-process communication in a software component.

methods.name: CcspComp_path_message_func
methods.description: Handles incoming DBus messages, creates a reply, and delegates processing to a base path message function.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_MessageBusEngage
methods.description: Initializes and connects to the message bus, sets callback functions, registers path and event signals.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_Initialize
methods.description: Initialization function for the message bus interface (currently returns success).

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_Finalize
methods.description: Finalizes the message bus interface, calls ssp_cancel, returns status.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_Buscheck
methods.description: Checks the bus status (currently always returns 0).

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_FreeResources
methods.description: Frees resources based on priority, calls ssp_cancel for high priority.
